g.title: mnichols08’s GitHub constellation
g.desc: 41 topics from 25 public repositories arranged in a deterministic identity ring point layout. Solid lines connect topics appearing in the same repository. Showing 41 of 41 categories, ranked by repository count. 95 of 301 shared connections shown. Brighter paths emphasize nearby relationships; faint paths preserve the remaining selected overlaps. Star size reflects repository count. Identity rings are seeded by the account name; ring points provide placement anchors for nodes. accessibility, contributing, github-profile-readme, garrett-county, linting, developer-tools, business-website, marketing-site, group-project, static-site, starter-kit, changelog, code-of-conduct, markdown-editor, profile-builder, mapbox-gl-js, dependabot, github, touris, best-practices, open-source-template, javascript, github-actions, interactive-map, yamllint, website-template, mapbox-api, performance, markdown, typescript, open-source, documentation, mapbox, deep-creek-lake, readme-generator, a11y, readme-editor, maryland, travel-guide, seo, security-policy. Recent public coding activity is most concentrated around 14:00–18:00 (UTC), based on available events in the last 30 days.
